origin-human-harbour: {fullName} grew up among the docks of Saltmere, a harbour city where every tide brought strangers and stories. {{He|She|They}} learned early to read faces faster than letters.
origin-human-farm: {firstName} spent {{his|her|their}} childhood on a farm at the edge of the Greywold, between golden wheat fields and the dark line of a forest every adult warned about.
origin-human-noble: {fullName} was raised in a minor noble house of Civitas, where manners cut deeper than swords and every dinner was a negotiation.
origin-human-refugee: Raiders burned {{his|her|their}} village when {firstName} was barely six. The years that followed were spent in a refugee camp on the King's Road, where kindness and hunger often slept under the same tent.
origin-elf-forest: {fullName} first opened {{his|her|their}} eyes beneath the silver canopy of Elysion, the oldest forest of the elves, where songs are older than kingdoms.
origin-elf-tower: Raised among the star-readers of the Moonspire, {firstName} knew the name of every constellation before taking a first step.
origin-elf-exile: {fullName} belongs to a family banished from the elven courts three centuries ago. Growing up among humans, {{he|she|they}} never quite belonged anywhere.
origin-elf-coast: On the misty shores of Aelinor, {firstName} grew up watching the sea-elves' ships sail west, never to return.
origin-dwarf-forge: {fullName} was born in the forge-hold of Kragnir's Spire, where the heartbeat of the mountain is the sound of a thousand hammers.
origin-dwarf-mine: Deep in the mines of the Delve, {firstName} grew up by lantern light, among miners who could tell true gold from fool's gold by its song.
origin-dwarf-clan: {fullName} comes from clan {lastName}, a proud line of stonewardens whose names are carved on the Great Gate.
origin-dwarf-surface: Unlike most of {{his|her|their}} kin, {firstName} was raised on the surface, in a trading post where dwarves, humans and the odd elf haggled over iron and wool.
origin-orc-steppe: {fullName} grew up on the wind-swept steppes of Khar-Duun, where the orc clans follow the herds and the storms.
origin-orc-city: {firstName} spent {{his|her|their}} youth in the shadow of human walls, in the orc quarter of Civitas, where respect had to be earned twice.
origin-orc-warband: {fullName} was raised in the Iron Tusk warband, where children learn to ride wolves before they learn to read.
origin-orc-shaman: Among the stone circles of the Ashen Hills, {firstName} grew up under the watch of a blind shaman who heard the spirits in the rain.
origin-halfling-burrow: {fullName} grew up in a hillside burrow in Greenhollow, where the doors are round, the pantries are full and every quarrel ends over a second breakfast.
origin-halfling-river: {fullName} was raised on a halfling riverboat that drifted from market to market. {{He|She|They}} learned to swim before {{he|she|they}} could walk, and to haggle soon after.
origin-halfling-inn: {fullName} is the youngest child of the family that runs the Tipsy Kettle, an inn at a crossroads. Every traveller who stopped there left {{him|her|them}} a story and a wish to see the world.
origin-halfling-orphan: Found in a basket on the steps of a human temple, {firstName} grew up among people twice {{his|her|their}} height, which taught {{him|her|them}} to be quick, clever and impossible to ignore.
origin-gnome-workshop: {fullName} grew up in a cluttered workshop in Cogsbury, where the kettle sang, the clocks argued and something was always about to explode.
origin-gnome-forest: {fullName} comes from a forest gnome village hidden under giant mushrooms, where neighbours are squirrels and secrets are kept by owls.
origin-gnome-library: {fullName} was born in the Great Index, an underground library run by gnomes who catalogue everything, including each other.
origin-gnome-circus: {fullName} grew up with a travelling gnome circus, fixing the clockwork lions by day and juggling fire by night.
origin-half-elf-two-worlds: {fullName} was born to an elven mother and a human father in a border town. Too elven for the village, too human for the forest, {{he|she|they}} learned to make a home in between.
origin-half-elf-court: {fullName} grew up at a human court as the ward of an elven envoy, learning two languages, two etiquettes and how to smile at both.
origin-half-elf-caravan: {fullName} was raised in a caravan of wanderers who welcomed anyone who did not fit elsewhere. Every road was home, and every camp a new family.
origin-half-elf-forest-edge: {fullName} grew up in a woodcutters' hamlet at the edge of an elven forest, where {{he was|she was|they were}} the only one the trees seemed to listen to.
origin-dark-elf-underdark: {fullName} was born in Vel'Ossa, a city of black stone deep beneath the world, where houses scheme in the dark and trust is a luxury few can afford.
origin-dark-elf-exile: {fullName} fled the underground cities after refusing a cruel order, and climbed to the surface to see the sun for the first time. It still hurts {{his|her|their}} eyes.
origin-dark-elf-house: {fullName} is a minor child of House {lastName}, raised among poisoned cups and silent servants, where every gift hides a knife.
origin-dark-elf-moonlit: {fullName} belongs to a small clan of dark elves who left the depths generations ago and now live in moonlit forests, at peace with the night.
origin-ashborn-pact: {fullName} carries the mark of a pact signed by an ancestor with an infernal power. The horns came with the bargain; the debt, nobody remembers.
origin-ashborn-slums: {fullName} grew up in the slums of Civitas, where people crossed the street to avoid {{his|her|their}} ember eyes. {{He|She|They}} learned early that fear is a weapon, and kindness a stronger one.
origin-ashborn-monastery: Left at the gates of a mountain monastery, {firstName} was raised by monks who believed no one is bound by their blood.
origin-ashborn-ashlands: {fullName} comes from the Ashlands, a land of cooled lava where the Ashborn built their own villages, far from those who called them cursed.
origin-human-mountain: {fullName} grew up in a shepherd village high in the mountains, where winters last half the year and every stranger is either a guest or a threat.
origin-human-camp: {fullName} was born in a mercenary camp and learned to walk between tents, war drums and card games that ended with drawn knives.
origin-elf-moon: {fullName} was raised in a temple of the moon hidden in an ancient forest, where elves sing to the night sky and remember every star by name.
origin-elf-orchard: {fullName} comes from an elven orchard-city where trees are grown into houses over centuries, and patience is the first thing every child learns.
origin-dwarf-brewery: {fullName} grew up in the family brewery of a great dwarven hold, where ale is a matter of honour and recipes are older than kings.
origin-dwarf-ruin: {fullName} was born after the fall of Kar-Dumhal, a dwarven hold taken by a dragon, and grew up among exiles who still dream of going home.
origin-orc-river: {fullName} comes from a river clan of orcs who fish, trade and fight from long boats, and who say that the river never lies.
origin-orc-adopted: Found as a baby after a border battle, {firstName} was raised by a human blacksmith who never asked anyone's permission to love a little orc.
origin-halfling-orchard: {fullName} grew up among the apple orchards of Bramblebrook, where the cider festival is the most important event of the year, wars included.
origin-halfling-lighthouse: {fullName} is the child of a lighthouse keeper on a rocky coast, and spent every stormy night watching for ships that might need help.
origin-gnome-mine: {fullName} grew up among gnome gem-cutters who live deep in the hills, where every stone has a voice for those patient enough to listen.
origin-gnome-observatory: {fullName} was raised in a gnomish observatory on a mountaintop, counting stars by night and fixing telescopes by day.
origin-half-elf-port: {fullName} grew up in a busy port where elves and humans trade side by side, and learned early to belong to both worlds and to neither.
origin-half-elf-temple: {fullName} was left at a temple as a baby and raised by priests who taught that every soul is welcome, whatever its blood.
origin-dark-elf-weavers: {fullName} comes from a family of spider-silk weavers in the dark cities, whose cloth is worth its weight in gold and whose secrets are worth more.
origin-dark-elf-arena: {fullName} grew up near the fighting pits beneath Vel'Ossa, where the noble houses settle their quarrels with other people's blood.
origin-ashborn-circus: {fullName} spent a childhood in a travelling circus, shown to crowds as a curiosity, until the day the cage door was left open.
origin-ashborn-noble: {fullName} was born into a noble family who hid the child's horns under hats and lies, and who still pretend the heir is travelling abroad.
origin-human-salt-mines: {fullName} was born in the salt-mining town of Brinewell, where the air tastes of the sea a hundred miles from any shore and everyone coughs by forty.
origin-human-caravan: {fullName} grew up on the wagons of a merchant caravan, learning a dozen tongues and the price of everything before {{he|she|they}} could read a map.
origin-elf-glacier: {fullName} comes from a hidden enclave carved into a glacier of the far north, where elves sing to the ice so that it never closes over them.
origin-elf-archive: {fullName} grew up among the living archives of Ilmarith, where every tree holds a memory and every child is taught to listen before speaking.
origin-dwarf-caravan: {fullName} was born on the long road between two holds, in a clan of dwarven traders who say the mountain is wherever the wagons stop for the night.
origin-dwarf-flooded: As a child, {fullName} survived the flooding of Karak Duun, carried through black water on a cousin's shoulders. The clan still mourns the deep halls it lost.
origin-orc-cages: As a child, {fullName} was sold to a southern slaver who meant {{him|her|them}} for the fighting pits. {{He|She|They}} escaped before the first bout and never forgot the smell of the cages.
origin-orc-hold: {fullName} grew up in a mountain hold that orcs and dwarves have shared, grudgingly, for three generations. {{He|She|They}} can curse fluently in both languages.
origin-halfling-barge: {fullName} was born on a river barge carrying apples and gossip from one market town to the next, and still sleeps best to the sound of water.
origin-halfling-mill: {fullName} grew up in the windmill of Little Hedging, where the whole village came to grind its grain and to tell the miller's family everything.
origin-gnome-clocktower: {fullName} grew up inside the great clocktower of Tindelburg, in a family whose only duty, for six generations, has been to keep it exactly on time.
origin-gnome-mushroom: {fullName} grew up in a burrow under a mushroom forest, where gnome children learn which caps heal, which ones glow and which ones make you see colours that do not exist.
origin-half-elf-embassy: {fullName} was born in an embassy, to a human envoy and an elven translator, and grew up being polite in two languages to people who distrusted both.
origin-half-elf-village: {fullName} grew up in a border village where the elves came to trade once a year, and where {{he|she|they}} belonged every day but that one.
origin-dark-elf-surface: {fullName} was born on the surface, to parents who had fled the Underdark, in a sunlit town that never quite decided to trust the family.
origin-dark-elf-fungus-farms: {fullName} grew up on the fungus farms that feed the city of Vel'Ossa, among workers the noble houses never bother to count.
origin-ashborn-caravanserai: {fullName} was left as a baby at a desert caravanserai, and grew up among camels, spice merchants and travellers who pretended not to notice the horns.
origin-ashborn-lighthouse: {fullName} grew up in a lighthouse on a stormy cape, where a reclusive family kept the flame burning and asked no questions about a child whose eyes glowed like it.
